### TAG-120: NKS CA-on-mesh: neighborhood-aware rule evaluation

## Software Notes

Extend the existing Rule 30 generator so a CA rule can evaluate against a vertex's actual mesh neighbors (from #2's adjacency data) instead of the current fixed 1D array neighborhood — this is what makes cellular automata run *on* arbitrary mesh geometry rather than just a flat strip.
